question: factures entre 2026-01-01 et 2026-01-07
sql_query:
SELECT
        f.ref AS facture_ref, 
        s.nom AS client,
        f.total_ht,
        f.total_ttc,
        f.datef AS date_facture
    FROM m38h_facture f
    LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
    WHERE f.datef BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    ORDER BY f.datef ASC

question: clients ayant plus de 2 commandes
sql_query:
SELECT c.rowid AS client_id,
           c.nom AS client_nom,
           COUNT(co.rowid) AS nb_commandes
    FROM m38h_societe c
    JOIN m38h_commande co ON co.fk_soc = c.rowid
    WHERE c.entity = 1
    GROUP BY c.rowid, c.nom
    HAVING nb_commandes > :min_commandes
    ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC

question: Factures non payées
sql_query:
SELECT
        f.ref AS facture_ref,
        s.nom AS client,
        f.total_ht,
        f.total_ttc,
        f.datef AS date_facture,
        COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0) AS montant_paye,
        (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) AS montant_restant
    FROM m38h_facture f
    LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
    LEFT JOIN m38h_paiement_facture pf ON pf.fk_facture = f.rowid
    WHERE f.entity = 1
    GROUP BY 
    f.rowid,
    f.ref,
    s.nom,
    f.total_ht,
    f.total_ttc,
    f.datef
    HAVING (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) > 0
    ORDER BY f.datef ASC
    LIMIT 100

question: factures non payees
sql_query:
SELECT
        f.ref AS facture_ref,
        s.nom AS client,
        f.total_ht,
        f.total_ttc,
        f.datef AS date_facture,
        COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0) AS montant_paye,
        (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) AS montant_restant
    FROM m38h_facture f
    LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
    LEFT JOIN m38h_paiement_facture pf ON pf.fk_facture = f.rowid
    WHERE f.entity = 1
    GROUP BY 
    f.rowid,
    f.ref,
    s.nom,
    f.total_ht,
    f.total_ttc,
    f.datef
    HAVING (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) > 0
    ORDER BY f.datef ASC
    LIMIT 100

question: factures non payées
sql_query:
SELECT
        f.ref AS facture_ref,
        s.nom AS client,
        f.total_ht,
        f.total_ttc,
        f.datef AS date_facture,
        COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0) AS montant_paye,
        (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) AS montant_restant
    FROM m38h_facture f
    LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
    LEFT JOIN m38h_paiement_facture pf ON pf.fk_facture = f.rowid
    WHERE f.entity = 1
    GROUP BY 
    f.rowid,
    f.ref,
    s.nom,
    f.total_ht,
    f.total_ttc,
    f.datef
    HAVING (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) > 0
    ORDER BY f.datef ASC
    LIMIT 100

SELECT p.ref AS produit_ref, 
           p.label AS produit_nom, 
           p.stock AS stock_disponible 
    FROM m38h_product p 
    WHERE p.stock < :stock_min
      AND p.entity = 1
    ORDER BY p.stock ASC
    LIMIT 100

question: clients avec plus de 2 commandes
sql_query:
SELECT c.rowid AS client_id,
           c.nom AS client_nom,
           COUNT(co.rowid) AS nb_commandes
    FROM m38h_societe c
    JOIN m38h_commande co ON co.fk_soc = c.rowid
    WHERE c.entity = 1
    GROUP BY c.rowid, c.nom
    HAVING nb_commandes > :min_commandes
    ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC
    LIMIT 100

question: Factures entre 2026-03-01 et 2026-03-25

question: Factures non payées
sql_query:
SELECT
        f.ref AS facture_ref,
        s.nom AS client,
        f.total_ht,
        f.total_ttc,
        f.datef AS date_facture,
        COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0) AS montant_paye,
        (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) AS montant_restant
    FROM m38h_facture f
    LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
    LEFT JOIN m38h_paiement_facture pf ON pf.fk_facture = f.rowid
    WHERE f.entity = 1
    GROUP BY 
    f.rowid,
    f.ref,
    s.nom,
    f.total_ht,
    f.total_ttc,
    f.datef
    HAVING (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) > 0
    ORDER BY f.datef ASC
    LIMIT 100

question: chiffre d affaires de octobre 2025
sql_query:
SELECT 
        DATE_FORMAT(f.datef, '%Y-%m') AS mois, 
        SUM(f.total_ht) AS CA_HT, 
        SUM(f.total_ttc) AS CA_TTC
    FROM m38h_facture f
    WHERE YEAR(f.datef) = :year 
      AND MONTH(f.datef) = :month
      AND f.entity = 1
    GROUP BY mois
    LIMIT 100

SELECT
        f.ref AS facture_ref,
        s.nom AS client,
        f.total_ht,
        f.total_ttc,
        f.datef AS date_facture,
        COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0) AS montant_paye,
        (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) AS montant_restant
    FROM m38h_facture f
    LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
    LEFT JOIN m38h_paiement_facture pf ON pf.fk_facture = f.rowid
    WHERE f.entity = 1
    GROUP BY 
    f.rowid,
    f.ref,
    s.nom,
    f.total_ht,
    f.total_ttc,
    f.datef
    HAVING (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) > 0
    ORDER BY f.datef ASC
    LIMIT 100

question: clients avec plus de 2 commandes
sql_query:
SELECT c.rowid AS client_id,
           c.nom AS client_nom,
           COUNT(co.rowid) AS nb_commandes
    FROM m38h_societe c
    JOIN m38h_commande co ON co.fk_soc = c.rowid
    WHERE c.entity = 1
    GROUP BY c.rowid, c.nom
    HAVING nb_commandes > :min_commandes
    ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC
    LIMIT 100

question: clients ayant passé plus de 3 commandes
sql_query:
SELECT c.rowid AS client_id,
           c.nom AS client_nom,
           COUNT(co.rowid) AS nb_commandes
    FROM m38h_societe c
    JOIN m38h_commande co ON co.fk_soc = c.rowid
    WHERE c.entity = 1
    GROUP BY c.rowid, c.nom
    HAVING nb_commandes > :min_commandes
    ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC
    LIMIT 100

question: Factures non payées
sql_query:
SELECT
        f.ref AS facture_ref,
        s.nom AS client,
        f.total_ht,
        f.total_ttc,
        f.datef AS date_facture,
        COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0) AS montant_paye,
        (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) AS montant_restant
    FROM m38h_facture f
    LEFT JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
    LEFT JOIN m38h_paiement_facture pf ON pf.fk_facture = f.rowid
    WHERE f.entity = 1
    GROUP BY
        f.rowid, f.ref, s.nom, f.total_ht, f.total_ttc, f.datef
    HAVING (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) > 0
    ORDER BY f.datef ASC
    LIMIT 100

        s.nom AS client,
        f.total_ht,
        f.total_ttc,

    HAVING (f.total_ttc - COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount), 0)) > 0
    ORDER BY f.datef ASC
    LIMIT 100

question: Évolution mensuelle du chiffre d'affaires avec taux de croissance
sql_query:
SELECT 
    YEAR(f.datef) AS annee,
    MONTH(f.datef) AS mois,
    SUM(f.total_ttc) AS chiffre_affaires,
    LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) AS ca_mois_precedent,
    (SUM(f.total_ttc) - LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)))
        / LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) * 100 AS croissance_pct
FROM m38h_facture f
WHERE f.entity = 1
GROUP BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)
ORDER BY annee, mois
LIMIT :limit

SELECT f.ref, s.nom AS client, f.total_ht, f.total_ttc
FROM m38h_facture f
JOIN m38h_societe s ON f.fk_soc = s.rowid
WHERE s.nom LIKE :client
AND f.entity = 1
LIMIT :limit

question: Produits générant le plus de CA.
sql_query:
SELECT
    p.ref,
    p.label AS produit,
    SUM(cd.total_ht) AS ca_ht,
    SUM(cd.total_ttc) AS ca_ttc,
    SUM(cd.qty) AS quantite
FROM m38h_commandedet cd
JOIN m38h_product p ON p.rowid = cd.fk_product
WHERE p.entity = 1
GROUP BY p.rowid, p.ref, p.label
ORDER BY ca_ttc DESC
LIMIT :limit

question: Évolution mensuelle du chiffre d'affaires avec taux de croissance
sql_query:
SELECT 
    YEAR(f.datef) AS annee,
    MONTH(f.datef) AS mois,
    SUM(f.total_ttc) AS chiffre_affaires,
    LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) AS ca_mois_precedent,
    (SUM(f.total_ttc) - LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)))
        / LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) * 100 AS croissance_pct
FROM m38h_facture f
WHERE f.entity = 1
GROUP BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)
ORDER BY annee, mois
LIMIT :limit

question: Valeur moyenne des commandes par client

question: Évolution mensuelle du chiffre d'affaires avec taux de croissance
sql_query:
SELECT 
    YEAR(f.datef) AS annee,
    MONTH(f.datef) AS mois,
    SUM(f.total_ttc) AS chiffre_affaires,
    LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) AS ca_mois_precedent,
    (SUM(f.total_ttc) - LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)))
        / LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) * 100 AS croissance_pct
FROM m38h_facture f
WHERE f.entity = 1
GROUP BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)
ORDER BY annee, mois
LIMIT :limit

question: évolution chiffre d affaires mensuel
sql_query:
SELECT 
    YEAR(f.datef) AS annee,
    MONTH(f.datef) AS mois,
    SUM(f.total_ttc) AS chiffre_affaires,
    LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) AS ca_mois_precedent,
    (SUM(f.total_ttc) - LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)))
        / LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) * 100 AS croissance_pct
FROM m38h_facture f
WHERE f.entity = 1
GROUP BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)
ORDER BY annee, mois
LIMIT :limit

question: évolution chiffre d affaires mensuel
sql_query:
SELECT 
    YEAR(f.datef) AS annee,
    MONTH(f.datef) AS mois,
    SUM(f.total_ttc) AS chiffre_affaires,
    LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) AS ca_mois_precedent,
    (SUM(f.total_ttc) - LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)))
        / LAG(SUM(f.total_ttc)) OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)) * 100 AS croissance_pct
FROM m38h_facture f
WHERE f.entity = 1
GROUP BY YEAR(f.datef), MONTH(f.datef)
ORDER BY annee, mois
LIMIT :limit

ORDER BY annee, mois
LIMIT :limit

sql_query:
SELECT
    p.ref,
    p.label AS produit,
    COALESCE(SUM(cd.total_ht), 0) AS ca_ht,
    COALESCE(SUM(cd.total_ttc), 0) AS ca_ttc,
    COALESCE(SUM(cd.qty), 0) AS quantite
FROM m38h_commandedet cd
JOIN m38h_product p ON p.rowid = cd.fk_product
WHERE p.entity = 1
GROUP BY p.rowid, p.ref, p.label
ORDER BY ca_ttc DESC
LIMIT :limit
